# Whole-tree audit synthesis — 197 verified findings (2026-08)

## Verdict

The tree is structurally healthy after the cleanup campaign: the guard suites, the engine/data split, the G-façade discipline, and the docs infrastructure all held up under adversarial audit — 197 findings confirmed, zero net refutations, and roughly 70% of them are prose drift or dead code, not behavior. The single most important discovery **corrects AUDIT-SYNTHESIS-2026-08.md FIX-NOW #3**: the curvature-sign campaign fixed the *labels* (agentview/apex/camera placement) but the retired `+k = right` convention is still **live behavior** in three engine consumers — kerbs built on the outside of every corner (mesh.js:204), tyre barriers on the inside (tracks.js:1549), corner boards inside (tracks.js:1601) — plus the same inversion class in the camera tuner's SIDE/YAW (cam-tune.js:145). The rest of the mess concentrates in four pockets: headers/docs describing retired designs (net signalling's Trystero era, WGX parity claims, the matTexMix "ships at 0" inversion, MQTT/two-backend leftovers); the data hub's freshness story (LIVE tab's refresh defeated by its own cache, hardcoded years); tools that exit 0 while measuring nothing (motion-capture, check-bank, the two fit sweeps clicking dead ids); and a long tail of comment drift in scenery/circuits. Nothing found undermines the restructure plan — R1/R2/R3 remain GO as scoped, and six findings fold cleanly into them.

Everything below is an immediate commit. **Batch A + B touch `js/`, `css/`, `index.html`, `sw.js`, `manifest.json` — land as at most three commits sharing ONE `?v=N` + `version.json` bump as the last edit** (`.claude/skills/bump-cache`), never mid-test-run. **Batch C is docs/tools/spike — no bump.** Run `node tools/verify-track.cjs <id>` for every track/circuit edit; `pick-tests` for the rest.

Under the established convention (+curv = LEFT turn; outer edge = +1 — mesh.js:92 and :114-115, spline.js:108-110 'a zero-steer run through a +k corner drifts to POSITIVE lateral'), sign>0 must give outside = +1, not -1. markBarrier at line 1570 and indexBarrier at 1576 then apply to the same wrong side.

confirmed.claim: transformSceneryApi ignores sceneryCoordinates:"racing" for sides and ranged helpers — SIDE always flips and ranges are always remapped as "source" — contradicting the mode contract space.js declares and sceneryFrac/sceneryNode honor, live on kyalami and paul_ricard (reverse:true + "racing").

So kyalami/paul_ricard get racing-space k/s but source-remapped ranges and mirrored sides — kyalami.js:84-87 documents the author compensating by hand ('`reverse: true` makes the engine flip every `side` argument before it reaches anchor()'), and unwrapped helpers (groundPatch, kyalami.js:290) take true racing coords, leaving three conventions in one file.
confirmed.fix: Make the wrapper honor the mode (identity SIDE and coordinateSpace "racing" for range when def.sceneryCoordinates==="racing"), migrating kyalami's/paul_ricard's hand-compensated side/range arguments in the same change.

confirmed.claim: Corner-number boards and braking-marker trios are erected on the corner INSIDE instead of the outside via the same inverted sign mapping.

confirmed.claim: spline.js contradicts itself about the turn-sign convention: the centerline() authoring doc says '+turn = right' while curvatureRaw() in the same file documents (with a measurement) that positive heading change is a LEFT turn.

confirmed.claim: The two Arquibancadas upper-terrace crowdBank calls pass node indices into a helper that takes lap fractions, so both banks collapse to node 0 (start/finish) as byte-identical overlapping geometry, and the Arquibancadas (s~0.83-0.85) gets no upper terrace at all.

confirmed.claim: The classification gap-bar feature keys on p.timeDiff, a field F1API.positions() never returns, so maxGap stays 0 and the gap bar/label never render.

confirmed.claim: refresh()'s Promise.all rejection handler is unreachable because every input promise already has .catch(catchLive) which swallows all errors by returning null.

confirmed.claim: renderTelemetryBody's rejection handler is unreachable: the preceding .catch converts every sessionDrivers failure into a resolved null.

confirmed.claim: fetchRetry identifies JSON.parse failures by V8-specific message strings, so on Firefox/Safari a non-JSON error body is rethrown as a raw SyntaxError — and for a 401/403 that message lacks 'HTTP 401'/'HTTP 403', defeating request()'s deliberate refusal to serve stale cache on auth lockouts.
confirmed.evidence: api.js:101 checks e.message against 'Unexpected end of JSON input' / 'Unexpected token' / 'Unexpected EOF' (Chrome/V8 wordings); Firefox emits 'JSON.parse: unexpected character...' (lowercase, no 'Unexpected token'), which passes the filter and is rethrown at :102 instead of falling through to the 'HTTP <status>' error at :105. The stale-cache guard at :133 matches only 'HTTP 401'/'HTTP 403'/'Live F1 session' in the message, so such a failure serves stale cache — exactly what the comment at :130-132 forbids.
confirmed.fix: Catch parse failures structurally (e.g. `if (e instanceof SyntaxError) {} else throw e`, or wrap only JSON.parse in its own try) instead of matching engine-specific message text.

confirmed.claim: meetingTtl and sessionTtl make opposite default choices for unknown recency: sessionTtl documents 'stay conservative' and returns the 10-min TTL, while meetingTtl returns the 7-day historic TTL for an unknown meeting — and also for a meeting whose date_start is still in the future.
confirmed.evidence: api.js:269-270 '// Unknown recency: stay conservative so genuinely-live data still refreshes. return TTL_LATEST;' vs api.js:275 'if (!ds) return TTL_HISTORIC;' and :277-279 where a negative age (future date_start) fails 'age >= 0' and yields TTL_HISTORIC, caching an upcoming weekend's session list for a week.
confirmed.fix: Make meetingTtl mirror sessionTtl: return TTL_LATEST for unknown keys and for age < 0 (future meetings).

confirmed.claim: The module header says final failures always serve stale cache when present, but the code deliberately refuses stale cache for live-session auth lockouts (401/403/'Live F1 session' messages).

confirmed.claim: The state-map comment documents a 'gen' field that the stored objects never contain.

confirmed.claim: The localStorage cache has no eviction: expired apex26.api.* entries (including ~50 KB car_data/location responses) accumulate forever, and once quota is hit every future write fails permanently with only a warning.

confirmed.claim: Livery nose-cap and nose/spine stripes are lofted to fixed z endpoints (3.185 / 3.14) while TEAM_STYLE.noseTipZ moves the actual nose tip by ±0.10 m, so on short-nosed teams the painted cap/stripe floats up to ~10 cm past the real nose tip (and stops short of it on long-nosed teams).

confirmed.claim: The shell version guard's stale-build reload drops location.hash, silently destroying VS FRIEND invite links (#vs=CODE) opened on a stale shell.

confirmed.claim: Escape on the qualifying classification clicks the deliberately-hidden BACK button and silently throws the quali result away.

confirmed.claim: track-detail.css (and topmodal.js) say #track-detail is 'now a real <dialog>' in the top layer, but index.html ships it as a <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true"> toggled via hidden — the migration the comments describe is not in the markup.

confirmed.fix: Either actually migrate the element to <dialog class="screen"> or correct both comments and drop aria-modal (or add real focus containment).

confirmed.claim: The network-first branch caches every uniquely cache-busted version.json?_=<timestamp> request under its full URL, adding one never-again-matched cache entry per app launch until the next build bump sweeps the cache.
confirmed.evidence: index.html:50 fetches "version.json?_=" + Date.now() on every load; sw.js:167 routes it here by pathname; sw.js:171 does cache.put(req, res.clone()) keyed on the full URL including the unique query; sw.js:184's caches.match(req) can never hit an older timestamped entry (default match includes the query), so entries only accumulate. Bonus oddity: offline, the same fallback line serves index.html's body for a version.json request (harmless only because the guard's .catch swallows the JSON parse error).
confirmed.fix: Skip caching version.json here (it is already precached as an essential), or put/match it under the bare "version.json" key.

confirmed.claim: The optional precache seeds every dynamically-injected vendor file except vendor/rapier-0.19.3/rapier.mjs — the one that is ON by default — so an installed-but-not-yet-raced offline PWA loses debris/incident physics.
